meta.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo AI Video Materials
meta.description: Batch-generate short video material clips without subtitles or voiceover for MoneyPrinterTurbo.
meta.inputSummary: Scene description, aspect ratio and scene index

steps.instruction: Generate an independent video material clip suitable for short-video editing. Do not generate subtitles, text, titles, watermarks, logos or spoken audio. Keep subject and camera motion natural and avoid sudden cuts.

instructions: Each row generates one independent MP4 video material clip.
The scene index keeps multiple materials on the same subject visually distinct.

fields.label: Scene description
fields.description: The video scene, subject, action and camera requirements to generate

presentation.placeholder: For example: staff using an AI assistant in a modern office, natural light, slow push-in shot

fields.label: Aspect ratio
fields.description: The aspect ratio used by the final MoneyPrinterTurbo video

fields.label: Scene index
fields.description: The scene number in this batch, starting from 1

values.scenePrompt: Staff using an AI assistant in a modern office, natural light, slow push-in shot, no text and no watermark
